summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are watching birds, but Conan proposes another game to them called "human watching". While teaching the Detective Boys how the game works, trying to determine people's jobs and occupations by watching them, they stumble upon detectives Takagi and Chiba apparently on a stakeout. Location: Shibata house Victim: Mika Shibata Suspects: People at the park The police officers are on a stakeout to watch Mr. Shibata carrying the ransom. They are waiting to see who will approach him and arrest that person, since it is likely to be the kidnapper.
